The '''Botor system''' was located in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds']] [[Botor Enclave/Legends|Botor Enclave]], a small territory of [[Realspace/Legends|space]] that had joined the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] by [[12,000 BBY/Legends|12,000 BBY]]. At one point located on the [[Hidakai Pool]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]], the [[Star system/Legends|star system]] remained a part of the Republic during such conflicts as the [[New Sith Wars]] and the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

Eventually, the system became a member of the Republic's successor, the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. The entire Botor Enclave declared its independence during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|war]] between the Empire and the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], and the [[New Republic Defense Force/Legends|military forces]] of the latter passed through the Botor system as part of the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]] in [[29 ABY/Legends|29 ABY]].

==Description==
The Botor [[Star system/Legends|system]] was located in the [[Southern Core]] portion of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]. It was one of the approximately two dozen [[Star/Legends|star]] systems situated on the fringes of a [[Nebula/Legends|nebula]] within the [[Botor Enclave/Legends|Botor Enclave]], a small area of [[Realspace/Legends|space]] inhabited by the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Botori]] [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="TEA" />

From approximately [[17,000 BBY]]<ref name="EGTW" /> to [[3956 BBY]], the Botor system lay on the [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]]<ref name="TEA" /> known as the [[Hidakai Pool]], which connected it to the [[Abregado system/Legends|Abregado]] and [[Daupherm system/Legends|Daupherm systems]].<ref name="EGTW" /> That [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] route, however, had ceased to exist by [[1004 BBY]].<ref name="TEA" />

==History==
The territory surrounding the Botor system was widely [[Scout/Legends|explored]] between [[15,000 BBY/Legends|15,000 BBY]] and [[8000 BBY]]. The Botor Enclave eventually accepted the status of an [[Allied Region]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]],<ref name="TEA" /> and the area, including the Botor system, had become a part of the Republic by approximately [[12,000 BBY/Legends|12,000 BBY]]<ref name="EGTW" /> and was considered a part of the civilized [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]] [[5000 BBY/Legends|seven millennia]] later.<ref name="TEA" />

[[File:Daupherm_Planet_States_-_Botor_Enclave.jpg|thumb|left|300px|The Botor system was a part of the Botor Enclave.]]
The system remained within the boundaries of the Republic during the final phase of the [[New Sith Wars]] from 1004 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]] to [[1000 BBY/Legends|1000 BBY]], and later during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] of [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]]&ndash;[[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].<ref name="TEA" /> During the first campaigns of the latter conflict, the [[Twentieth Army]] of the Republic was tasked with protecting the vicinity of the Botor system against the [[Confederacy military/Legends|military forces]] of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].<ref name="EGTW" /> Shortly after the acquisition of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ukio/Legends|Ukio]] by the [[Commerce Guild/Legends|Commerce Guild]] during that conflict, the Botor system was highlighted on a [[Galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Map/Legends|map]] that featured various locations of interest to the Confederacy and was displayed on a [[Viewscreen/Legends|viewscreen]] at a facility run by [[Passel Argente/Legends|Passel Argente]], the [[Magistrate/Legends|Magistrate]]<ref name="AoI">''[[The Clone Wars: Act on Instinct]]''</ref> of the [[Corporate Alliance/Legends|Corporate Alliance]].<ref name="DB Argente">{{DB|character|passelargente|Argente, Passel}}</ref>

By [[17 BBY/Legends|17 BBY]], the system had been incorporated into the territory of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]],<ref name="EGTW" /> although the entire Botor Enclave declared its independence during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|struggle]] between the fragmented Empire and the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] more than two [[Standard decade/Legends|decades]] later. The population of the Botor system numbered between 100 million to 500 million around [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]]. [[29 ABY/Legends|Four years]] later, [[New Republic Defense Force/Legends|New Republic military forces]] passed through the Botor system as part of the [[Yuuzhan Vong War|war effort]] against the [[Yuuzhan Vong galaxy|extragalactic]] [[Yuuzhan Vong]] invaders.<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Botor system was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square K-12.<ref name="TEA" /> ''[[The Clone Wars: Act on Instinct]]'', a [[Star Wars comic books|webcomic]] authored by [[Pablo Hidalgo]] and released on [[StarWars.com]]<ref name="AoI" /> over the span of the 2009<ref name="AoI announcement">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/news20091001comics/index.html|text=New ''Clone Wars'' Web Comic Tells Original Tale}}</ref>&ndash;[[2010]]<ref name="Lethal Trackdown Ep Guide">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode222.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Lethal Trackdown}}</ref> [[The Clone Wars: Season Two|second season]] of the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series,<ref name="AoI announcement" /> featured the first appearance of the system.<ref name="AoI" />
